title: Gallformers import — shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by taxonomy batches and gall batches: the envelope, the Source block, taxon references, evidence, and controlled-value wrappers. PRODUCER_GUIDE.md holds the rules beyond the schemas' shape.

envelope.description: Fields every batch carries. Each batch schema adds its own content and fixes batch_type.

format.description: Identifies the file as a Gallformers import batch.

format_version.description: The version of the import format this batch follows.

vocabulary_version.description: The vocabulary_version the vocab/ files carry (one date, shared by all of them): the lists this batch's controlled values come from.

batch_type.description: taxonomy for taxonomy.json; gall for gall.json.

mode.description: replace: a full run over this Source, superseding every earlier batch of this batch_type from it. add: statements that supplement earlier batches from this Source. Gallformers batches use add.

batch_id.description: A unique ID for this batch, such as a UUID.

producer.description: Who or what produced the batch: the tool's name and version, plus the model and the instructions version when there are any.

model.description: The model used, if any (exact model ID).

instructions_version.description: Version of the prompt/skill set used, if any.

source.description: Exactly one Source per batch: Gallformers itself (when it has the gallformers key), otherwise a document Source.

gallformers_source.description: Gallformers' own statements (author: Gallformers Contributors). The gallformers key is the whole block; each statement carries its own date and text in its evidence. Batches with this Source use mode add.

document_source.description: A publication, website, database, unpublished work, or research data.

gallformers_source_id.description: Optional: Gallformers' ID for this Source, given only when known for certain. It must match the bibliographic fields.

authors.description: The authors' names exactly as written, in order.

authored.description: The Source's single date, the one that decides which Source is newer. For a website: the date of the version read — its stated last-modified date, or else the access date.

as_written.description: The date as the Source states it, e.g. '1999 with ongoing revisions, accessed 2022'.

citation.description: The full citation as it should be displayed.

as_written.description: The license or rights statement as found, or 'not stated'.

document.description: The phase 1 document (a DoclingDocument, document.json) beside this batch, and its sha256.

retracts.description: On a retraction notice only: the Source the notice retracts.

taxon_ref.description: A taxon the Source names, declared once and referred to by ref. It is identified by its name, exactly as the Source writes it, and its rank.

name_as_written.description: The name verbatim from the document, OCR damage included, so it matches the quotes.

name_reading.description: Optional. The evident printed name when the document's text of it is damaged by OCR or extraction ("Cynips Jlocossa" → "Cynips flocossa"). It repairs damaged letters only; the author's own spelling stays as written.

sensu.description: Optional. For a misapplied name (one used for the wrong species): the usage the Source means, as written ("O. S. non Harris").

new.description: Novelty the Source itself claims: sp. nov., gen. nov., subgen. nov., comb. nov., comb. rev., stat. nov., stat. rev., nom. nov.

status.description: As written, e.g. 'sp. nov.', 'new species', 'comb. rev.'.

gallformers_taxon_id.description: Optional: Gallformers' ID for this taxon, given only when known for certain. It must match the name.

act_id.description: Batch-unique taxonomic act ID: a1, a2, …

stance.description: confirm: the Source states it. deny: the Source corrects a published statement (PRODUCER_GUIDE.md rule 6).

evidence.description: At least one per Fact or act. A quote from the document, or (Gallformers batches only) a dated statement.

quote_evidence.description: Evidence from the Source's document: a verbatim quote and the item it appears in, or a whole item.

item.description: Reference of the document item the evidence comes from (a DoclingDocument self_ref, e.g. '#/texts/42'). Required whenever the batch has a document.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the item, long enough to be unambiguous within it.

whole_item.description: The evidence is the item's entire text (e.g. a descriptive paragraph). Use it with item, in place of quote, in a batch with a document.

page.description: The page number as printed in the Source, if known.

url.description: Deep link to this place in the Source (e.g. a scanned-book page or a website's species page).

cites.description: Optional. The work the Source cites for this statement ("Q. alba (Kinsey 1923)"). The statement is still this Source's own.

as_written.description: The citation as the Source gives it, e.g. 'Kinsey 1923'.

statement_evidence.description: Gallformers batches only: Gallformers' own statement.

unmapped.description: Source terms that fit no vocabulary value, each recorded here with its evidence in place of a Fact. A value is used only when its definition fits; a near miss belongs here.

slot.description: Which vocabulary it would have belonged to.

gall.description: The Gall it describes, if any (gall batches).

note.description: Optional: why no value fits, or a suggested new value.

observations.description: Observations the statement cites, as its evidence.
